title: FactorIA streamed world index (*.world.json)
description: The index of a streamed world: the grid of cells (each one a scene file) that the engine loads and unloads around the StreamingAnchor entities. A StreamedWorld component names the file. Errors name the file and the JSON pointer; docs/BIG_WORLDS.md, "Streaming", explains the format and `world.cells {}` lists the cells at run time.

format.description: File format identifier. Always "factoria.world/1" (an unknown value is a warning).

version.description: Version of the index format. Always 1.

dimension.description: "3d": the cells are laid out on the XZ plane and the height never matters; "2d": on the XY plane.

cellSize.description: Metres (units of the world) along each side of a cell.

origin.description: Where cell [0, 0] starts on the plane (absolute: the floating origin plus the local position).

persistent.description: Optional. The project-relative scene file that holds what is not in any cell: the entities that stay loaded and the scene's settings. world.split_cells writes it and world.merge_cells reads it back; the engine does not load it by itself (make it the project's main scene).

cells.description: The cells, in any order (the engine sorts them by [j, i]). Two entries with the same coord are an error.

coord.description: [i, j]: i along x, j along z (3d) or y (2d). The cell covers origin + [i, j] * cellSize up to one cellSize more.

scene.description: Project-relative scene file of the cell (e.g. "cells/3_-2.scene.json"). Every entity id in it must be unique across the whole world.

bounds.description: What the cell's entities cover, absolute, inside the cell's square. Distances to a cell (StreamingAnchor.loadRadius) are taken to these bounds.

min.description: [x, y, z] in a 3d index, [x, y] in a 2d one.

max.description: [x, y, z] in a 3d index, [x, y] in a 2d one; at least min on every axis.

sizeBytes.description: Optional: the size of the cell's scene file, a hint for the debug view.
